en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a Dutch polder landscape with a waterway in the foreground, reed-covered banks, and at least three traditional windmills spaced along the horizon. In the distance there is a church tower or spire rising above a village. Handwritten and printed captions appear along the bottom margin, and the word "Zaandamstek" (likely Zaandam/Zaandstreek) is visible at the right.
